name: identity_desync_sprint
label: Kinetic Self-Fracture
godotFeature: CharacterBody3D movement, PhysicsServer3D collision manipulation, WorldEnvironment shader_global effects
poeticVision: The desperate panic of your own body betraying you mid-sprint. Every rapid step through corrupted memory tears at your physical self, threatening to dissolve your form or pull you through reality itself. You fight against the very momentum of forgetting, relying on sheer will to stay 'present' in the world, knowing a single misstep means oblivion.

parameters.name: max_desync_level
parameters.description: Maximum desynchronization intensity Lyra can reach.

parameters.name: desync_gain_rate
parameters.description: Rate at which desynchronization level increases per second when conditions are met.

parameters.name: desync_decay_rate
parameters.description: Rate at which desynchronization level decreases per second when conditions are not met.

parameters.name: velocity_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum velocity magnitude required for desynchronization to start increasing.

parameters.name: jitter_intensity
parameters.description: Maximum random offset applied to Lyra's movement vectors due to desynchronization.

parameters.name: phasing_layer_to_ignore
parameters.description: The collision layer (1-32) that Lyra will temporarily ignore collision with for partial phasing effects. Set this to a layer used by minor environmental elements.

parameters.name: phasing_toggle_interval
parameters.description: The interval in seconds at which Lyra's collision mask toggles for phasing.

parameters.name: identity_cost_threshold
parameters.description: The desynchronization level at which Lyra risks suffering an 'identity cost' and stumbling.

parameters.name: desync_stumble_force
parameters.description: The magnitude of the force applied to Lyra when she stumbles due to critical desynchronization.

parameters.name: stumble_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which Lyra remains in a stumbling state.

parameters.name: global_environment_material
parameters.description: Reference to the ShaderMaterial used by the WorldEnvironment's custom sky or background. Used for global visual desync feedback.

parameters.name: lyra_mesh_material
parameters.description: Reference to the ShaderMaterial applied to Lyra's mesh, which should use a vertex shader for displacement effects.

dependencies: CharacterBody3D (this script is attached to it)
Area3D (for defining corrupted memory zones and calling set_corrupted_zone_status)
identity_desync_global.gdshader (a custom sky/background shader for WorldEnvironment)
identity_desync_vertex.gdshader (a custom spatial shader for Lyra's mesh)
verdict: A brilliant fusion of physical peril and existential dread, turning every desperate stride into a battle against the self and the encroaching void.
impact: This mechanic fundamentally transforms player movement from a simple traversal into a desperate, high-stakes gamble. Every sprint through a corrupted zone becomes a visceral struggle against the player's own body and the encroaching void of forgetting. It introduces a constant, palpable tension, forcing players to manage their 'desync' as a critical resource, making split-second decisions between speed and self-preservation. The visual feedback, jitter, phasing, and sudden stumbles create a deeply unsettling and memorable experience, directly embodying the game's core themes of self-loss and urgent survival.
